parent_objective: run exact-gated actor_mean-only temporal sequence objective update probe
blocked_by: M1001 admits only a tiny exact objective-only actor_mean update probe
invalidates: running PPO or replay gates before exact candidate selection

public_gates: M1002 must select candidates only by exact objective gates
M1002 must not use diagnostic cross-fault rows as positives
forbidden_shortcuts: do not add hidden event labels to actor observations
do not update GRU or encoders
do not claim cross-fault wrong-history self-ID
do not train variant histories toward degraded actions

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: tests whether the M999/M1000 exact objective can produce a trust-region candidate before replay gates
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: objective-only candidate probe; no PPO, no promotion, no private holdout
stop_condition: stop if no alpha passes exact gates
stop if any non-actor_mean parameter changes
stop if action drift exceeds the exact trust region
fallback_plan: if no exact candidate exists, audit objective coefficients and gap floor
if actor_mean-only is too weak, design a separate trainable-surface audit
if exact candidate exists, route to public replay gate design

hypothesis: A small actor_mean-only update over the M997 temporal objective can produce an exact-gate-passing candidate without PPO or promotion.
failure_criteria: diagnostic cross-fault rows are positive targets

commands.name: probe
commands.command: implement and run exact actor_mean-only update probe; see docs/m1001-v4-public-base-temporal-sequence-objective-update-design.md

decision_rule: M1002 should route to public replay gate design only if an exact objective-level candidate passes all M1001 gates.
